title: Apportioning a Reinspection Visit That Served Other Work — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Rule.** Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, how the reinspection charge is taken from the visit charge follows what else that visit served on the re-measurement date: where a walkthrough was held at the home that day, no reinspection charge is made; where no walkthrough was held that day but the coverage records covered work that day (an inspection that confirmed a defect or a completed repair), the visit charge is shared equally between the re-measured item and each such covered-work entry and the reinspection charge is the re-measured item's share; where neither was recorded that day, the reinspection charge is the whole visit charge.

## Input, judgement, output

| Recorded on the re-measurement date | Judgement | Reinspection charge |
|---|---|---|
| A walkthrough held at the home | Visit served the walkthrough | None |
| No walkthrough; one or more covered-work entries | Visit shared | The visit charge divided equally among the re-measured item and each covered-work entry; the item's share |
| Neither | Visit served the re-measurement alone | The whole visit charge |

Each defect-confirming inspection and each completed repair recorded on the coverage that day is one covered-work entry.

## Worked cases (hypothetical visit charge USD 90.00)

- One completed repair recorded that day: shared between 2, reinspection charge USD 45.00.
- One defect-confirming inspection and one completed repair that day: shared among 3, reinspection charge USD 30.00.
- An eleven-month walkthrough held that day, with a completed repair as well: no reinspection charge.
